messages:
Claire (People Ops): Morning team — sharing a compact first-week manager checklist + a simple 30/60/90 sketch for new hires. Please adapt for your hire and ping me if anything missing.
Marco (Eng Manager): Thanks Claire — can you add where to put project-specific goals? Also need a template I can hand to new IC.
Claire (People Ops): yes — added a 'project goals' section under day 1-2. here's a tiny template below you can paste into offer docs:

```
Day 1: intro, workstation, security training, meet team (30m), 1:1 with manager (30m)
Day 2: repo access, infra walkthrough, first small task
Week 1: setup, shadowing, small commit, 1:1 weekly goals
30/60/90 (manager sketch):
 30d: ramp, complete onboarding tasks, own first small bug/feature
 60d: independent feature work, begin owning a small component
 90d: deliver initial project milestone, propose improvement
Success metrics: ramp time, PR reviews, cross-team comms, docs contributed
```

Claire (People Ops): also checklist items for managers:
- schedule recurring 1:1 (30m weekly)
- assign onboarding buddy
- create initial sprint ticket
- set first-week measurable goal
- add hire to relevant calendars and Slack channels

Jen (IT): I will provision laptop and repo access. @Marco — which repos? list here and I'll add rights.
Marco (Eng Manager): repo: infra-auth, ui-dashboard, starter-kit. Also need staging creds for feature dev.
Jen (IT): staging creds will be created once IAM group assigned. I'll follow up with invite by EOD.
Priya (HRBP): Reminder: complete employment forms + compliance training within 72h. I can run a quick live walkthrough if helpful.
Marco (Eng Manager): can we get a calendar template for week 1? simple half-day blocks for intro + deep work.
Claire (People Ops): attaching quick schedule (pasteable):

```
Mon AM: 1:1 with manager + team intros
Mon PM: security + infra access
Tue AM: repo walkthrough + buddy pairing
Tue PM: first small task
Wed: shadowing + doc time
Thu: independent dev time + sync
Fri: 30m sync, retro, next week plan
```

Claire (People Ops): also thought: 30/60/90 should tie to measurable deliverables — not just 'learn'. sample goal for first feature: "Ship feature X toggle behind flag, tests + basic docs".
Marco (Eng Manager): perfect. will copy and adapt. thanks :tada:
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: send 'Welcome pack' DM to new hire at 09:00 on their start date :bell:
Priya (HRBP): I'll add the payroll/benefits checklist in the offer folder and share link.
Marco (Eng Manager): thanks all — i'll prepare the project brief and share by Friday.
Claire (People Ops): great — tag me if you want us to run the 30/60/90 calibration with hiring manager rubric. :heart:
